verses.geez: ብእሲሰ፡ አብድ፡ ከንቶ፡ ይሴፈዋ፡ ለሐሰት፡ ወሕልምኒ፡ ያደነግጾ፡ ለአብድ።
verses.translation: The hopes of a man void of understanding are vain and false: and dreams lift up fools.

translations.lxx: The hopes of a man void of understanding are vain and false: and dreams lift up fools.
translations.ron: Privegherea celui bogat topeşte trupul lui şi grija lui strică somnul.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ዘይፀብጥ፡ ጽላሎተ፡ ወከመ፡ ዘይዴግን፡ ነፋሰ፡ ከማሁ፡ ዘይትአመን፡ ሕልመ።
verses.translation: Whoso regardeth dreams is like him that catcheth at a shadow, and followeth after the wind.

translations.lxx: Whoso regardeth dreams is like him that catcheth at a shadow, and followeth after the wind.
translations.ron: Grija privegherii goneşte aţipirea şi ca boala grea alungă somnul.

verses.geez: እምዝንቱ፡ ውስተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይትፋለስ፡ ሕልመ፡ ወበበ፡ አምሳለ፡ ገጹ፡ ያርእየከ፡ ዘዘዚአሁ።
verses.translation: The vision of dreams is the resemblance of one thing to another, even as the likeness of a face to a face.

translations.lxx: The vision of dreams is the resemblance of one thing to another, even as the likeness of a face to a face.
translations.ron: Ostenitu-s-a bogatul strângând bani şi întru odihna sa se satură de desfătările sale.

verses.geez: እምውስተ፡ ርኵስ፡ ምንት፡ ይወፅእ፡ ንጹሕ፡ ወበውስተ፡ ሐሰት፡ በአይቴ፡ ይትረክብ፡ ጽድቅ።
verses.translation: Of an unclean thing what can be cleansed? and from that thing which is false what truth can come?

translations.lxx: Of an unclean thing what can be cleansed? and from that thing which is false what truth can come?
translations.ron: Săracul se zbuciumă pentru că nu are cu ce trăi, iar când se odihneşte toate îi lipsesc.

verses.geez: ሕልም፡ ወሰገል፡ ወመቅሰም፡ ከንቱ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ወያደነግጹ፡ ልብ፡ ወይቀንዑ፡ ከመ፡ ማሕምም።
verses.translation: Divinations, and soothsayings, and dreams, are vain: and the heart fancieth, as a woman's heart in travail.

translations.lxx: Divinations, and soothsayings, and dreams, are vain: and the heart fancieth, as a woman's heart in travail.
translations.ron: Cel care iubeşte aurul nu se va îndrepta şi cel care aleargă după stricăciune se va sătura de ea.

verses.geez: ለእመ፡ ኢኮነ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘተፈነወ፡ እመ፡ ይሣሀል፡ ኢትደዮ፡ ውስተ፡ ልብከ።
verses.translation: If they be not sent from the most High in thy visitation, set not thy heart upon them.

translations.lxx: If they be not sent from the most High in thy visitation, set not thy heart upon them.
translations.ron: Mulţi au căzut pentru aur şi înaintea lor le-a fost pieirea.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ለብዙኃን፡ አስሐቶሙ፡ ሕልም፡ ወወደቁ፡ እንዘ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ይሴፈው።
verses.translation: For dreams have deceived many, and they have failed that put their trust in them.

translations.lxx: For dreams have deceived many, and they have failed that put their trust in them.
translations.ron: Lemn de împiedicare este aurul celor ce-i jertfesc lui şi tot cel fără de minte se va prinde în el.

verses.geez: እሙነ፡ ይበጽሕ፡ ዘእምኀበ፡[እግዚአብሔር፡]፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ሐሰት፡ ወጥዩቀ፡ ይከውን፡ ቃለ፡ ጽድቅ።
verses.translation: The law shall be found perfect without lies: and wisdom is perfection to a faithful mouth.

translations.lxx: The law shall be found perfect without lies: and wisdom is perfection to a faithful mouth.
translations.ron: Fericit este bogatul care s-a aflat fără de prihană şi după aur n-a umblat.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ ምሁር፡ ተግሣጸ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ያአምር፡ ወዘፈድፋደ፡ ሐመመ፡ ጥበበ፡ ይነርግ።
verses.translation: A man that hath travelled knoweth many things: and he that hath much experience will declare wisdom.

translations.lxx: A man that hath travelled knoweth many things: and he that hath much experience will declare wisdom.
translations.ron: Cine este acesta? Şi-l vom ferici, că a făcut lucruri minunate întru poporul său.

verses.geez: ወዘሰ፡ ኢትጐድአ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘየአምር።
verses.translation: He that hath no experience knoweth little: but he that hath travelled is full of prudence.

translations.lxx: He that hath no experience knoweth little: but he that hath travelled is full of prudence.
translations.ron: Cine a fost încercat cu aurul şi a rămas desăvârşit şi i-a fost lui spre laudă?

verses.geez: ዘብዙኀ፡ ተመንደበ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ይትሜ[የን]።
verses.translation: When I travelled, I saw many things; and I understand more than I can express.

translations.lxx: When I travelled, I saw many things; and I understand more than I can express.
translations.ron: Cine este acela care a putut călca porunca şi n-a călcat-o? Şi a putut face rău şi n-a făcut?

verses.geez: ብዙኀ፡ ርኢኩ፡ አመ፡ ተመንደብኩ፡ ወበዝኀ፡ ቃልየ፡ እምነ፡ ኅሊናየ።
verses.translation: I was oft-times in danger of death: yet I was delivered because of these things.

translations.lxx: I was oft-times in danger of death: yet I was delivered because of these things.
translations.ron: Se vor întări bunătăţile lui şi milosteniile lui le va povesti adunarea.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዘልፈ፡ እትመነደብ፡ ወእበጽሕ፡ ለሞት፡ ወእንበይነዝ፡ ያድኅነኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: The spirit of those that fear the Lord shall live; for their hope is in him that saveth them.

translations.lxx: The spirit of those that fear the Lord shall live; for their hope is in him that saveth them.
translations.ron: Când şezi la masă mare, să nu deschizi spre ea gura ta,

verses.geez: ነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ ትፈርሆ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ተሐዩ።
verses.translation: Whoso feareth the Lord shall not fear nor be afraid; for he is his hope.

translations.lxx: Whoso feareth the Lord shall not fear nor be afraid; for he is his hope.
translations.ron: Şi să nu zici: "Multe sunt puse pe masă!" Adu-ţi aminte că rău lucru este ochiul viclean.

verses.geez: ወይድኅኑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ይሴፈው፡ ኪያሁ።
verses.translation: Blessed is the soul of him that feareth the Lord: to whom doth he look? and who is his strength?

translations.lxx: Blessed is the soul of him that feareth the Lord: to whom doth he look? and who is his strength?
translations.ron: Ce este mai rău între lucrurile create, decât ochiul viclean? Pentru aceea la toate câte vede lăcrimează.

verses.geez: ለፈራሄ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይጌርሞ፡ ወኢይደነግጽ፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ተስፋሁ።
verses.translation: For the eyes of the Lord are upon them that love him, he is their mighty protection and strong stay, a defence from heat, and a cover from the sun at noon, a preservation from stumbling, and an help from falling;

translations.lxx: For the eyes of the Lord are upon them that love him, he is their mighty protection and strong stay, a defence from heat, and a cover from the sun at noon, a preservation from stumbling, and an help from falling;
translations.ron: Să nu-ţi întinzi mâna unde altul se va uita, ca să nu-ţi bagi mâna cu el în blid.

verses.geez: ብፅዕት፡ ነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ ትፈርሆ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: he raiseth up the soul, and lighteneth the eyes: he giveth health, life, and blessing.

translations.lxx: he raiseth up the soul, and lighteneth the eyes: he giveth health, life, and blessing.
translations.ron: Din tine însuţi cunoaşte ale aproapelui şi la tot lucrul gândeşte.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ያሰክም፡ ወውእቱ፡ ምእመኑ።
verses.translation: He that sacrificeth of a thing wrongfully gotten, his offering is ridiculous; and the gifts of unjust men are not accepted.

translations.lxx: He that sacrificeth of a thing wrongfully gotten, his offering is ridiculous; and the gifts of unjust men are not accepted.
translations.ron: Mănâncă cuviincios cele ce sunt puse înaintea ta şi nu plescăi, ca să nu te faci nesuferit.

verses.geez: አዕይንቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ እለ፡ ያፈቅርዎ፡ ምእመን፡ ኀይሉ፡ ወጽኑፅ፡ ምስማኩ። ያቈርር፡ ለከ፡ መርቄ፡ ወይጼልለከ፡ እምፀሓየ፡ ቀትር፡ የዐቅበከ፡ እምዕቅፍት፡ ወይረድአከ፡ እምድቀት።
verses.translation: The most High is not pleased with the offerings of the wicked; neither is he pacified for sin by the multitude of sacrifices.

translations.lxx: The most High is not pleased with the offerings of the wicked; neither is he pacified for sin by the multitude of sacrifices.
translations.ron: Isprăveşte cuviincios cel dintâi şi nu fi nesăţios, ca să nu sminteşti.

verses.geez: ያዐብያ፡ ለነፍስከ፡ ወያበርሆን፡ ለአዕይንቲከ፡ ወይፌውስኒ፡ ወይሁብ፡ ሕይወተ፡ ወያጸግብ፡ በረከተ።
verses.translation: Whoso bringeth an offering of the goods of the poor doeth as one that killeth the son before his father's eyes.

translations.lxx: Whoso bringeth an offering of the goods of the poor doeth as one that killeth the son before his father's eyes.
translations.ron: Şi când şezi între mai mulţi, să nu întinzi mâna ta mai înainte de ei.

verses.geez: ርኵስ፡ መሥዋዕቱ፡ ለመባአ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ወግሙን፡ ቊርባኖሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን።
verses.translation: The bread of the needy is their life: he that defraudeth him thereof is a man of blood.

translations.lxx: The bread of the needy is their life: he that defraudeth him thereof is a man of blood.
translations.ron: Omul bine-crescut se îndestulează cu puţin şi în aşternutul său nu va gâfâi de prea multă mâncare.

verses.geez: ወኢይትወከፎሙ፡ መባኦሙ፡ ለረሲዓን።
verses.translation: He that taketh away his neighbour's living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer his hire is a bloodshedder.

translations.lxx: He that taketh away his neighbour's living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer his hire is a bloodshedder.
translations.ron: Cu somn sănătos se odihneşte pântecele celui cumpătat; se scoală dimineaţa şi sufletul lui e limpede.

verses.geez: አኮ፡ በብዝኀ፡ መባእከ፡ ዘይትኀደግ፡ ለከ፡ ኀጢአትከ።
verses.translation: When one buildeth, and another pulleth down, what profit have they then but labour?

translations.lxx: When one buildeth, and another pulleth down, what profit have they then but labour?
translations.ron: Truda nesomnului şi a greţii şi durerile îmbuibării sunt cu omul nesăţios.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ዘይቀትሎ፡ ለሕፃን፡ በቅድመ፡ አቡሁ፡ ከማሁ፡ ዘበንዋየ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ያበውእ፡ መባእ።
verses.translation: When one prayeth, and another curseth, whose voice will the Lord hear?

translations.lxx: When one prayeth, and another curseth, whose voice will the Lord hear?
translations.ron: Şi de te-ai silit în mâncăruri, scoală-te, du-te împrejur şi te vei simţi uşurat.

verses.geez: ሕይወቱ፡ ለነዳይ፡ ስኢለ፡ ምጽዋት፡ ወዘሰ፡ አበዮ፡ ቀታሌ፡ ነፍስ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: He that washeth himself after the touching of a dead body, if he touch it again, what availeth his washing?

translations.lxx: He that washeth himself after the touching of a dead body, if he touch it again, what availeth his washing?
translations.ron: Ascultă-mă, fiule, şi bagă de seamă şi mai pe urmă vei înţelege cuvintele mele.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ዘቀተለ፡ ቢጾ፡ ዘፈለጠ፡ ብእሴ፡ እምብእሲቱ።
verses.translation: So is it with a man that fasteth for his sins, and goeth again, and doeth the same: who will hear his prayer? or what doth his humbling profit him?

translations.lxx: So is it with a man that fasteth for his sins, and goeth again, and doeth the same: who will hear his prayer? or what doth his humbling profit him?
translations.ron: În toate lucrurile tale fii cumpătat şi nici o neputinţă nu te va întâmpina.

verses.geez: ወዘሄደ፡ ዐስቦ፡ ለዐሳቡ፡ ከዐወ፡ ደሞ።

translations.ron: Pe cel ce dă ospeţe strălucite, îl vor binecuvânta buzele şi mărturia dărniciei lui este întemeiată.

verses.geez: ሶበ፡ ፩ዱ፡ የሐንጽ፡ ወካልኡ፡ ይነሥት፡ ምንተ፡ በቊዐ፡ ጻማሆሙ፡ ለክልኤሆሙ።

translations.ron: Asupra mesei zgârcitului va cârti cetatea şi mărturia răutăţii lui este adevărată.

verses.geez: ሶበ፡ ፩ዱ፡ ይድኅር፡ ወካልኡ፡ ይረግም፡ ለመኑ፡ እምውስተ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ይሰምዖሙ፡ ቃሎሙ።

translations.ron: La vin nu te face viteaz, că pe mulţi i-a pierdut vinul.

verses.geez: ዘይትኀፀብ፡ እምድኅር፡ ገሲሶ፡ በድነ፡ ወካዕበ፡ ይደግም፡ ገሲሶ፡ ምንተ፡ በቊዖ፡ ተኀፅቦ።

translations.ron: Cuptorul încearcă oţelul călit; tot aşa şi vinul, inimile trufaşilor, care stau gata să se încaiere.

verses.geez: ከማሁ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘይጸውም፡ እንበይነ፡ ኀጢአቱ፡ ወካዕበ፡ የሐውር፡ ዳግመ፡ የአብስ። መኑ፡ እንከ፡ ይሰምዖ፡ ጸሎቶ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወምንተ፡ በቊዖ፡ አሕምሞ፡ ነፍሶ።

translations.ron: Întocmai ca apa pentru viaţă este pentru om vinul, de-l vei bea cu măsură.
